from pathlib import Path
import re, subprocess, unicodedata
files = [Path(p) for p in ['README.md', 'DEVELOPMENT.md', 'scripts/README.md', 'DEVELOPMENT-HISTORY.md']]
def anchors(path):
    result = set()
    for title in re.findall(r'"'^#{1,6} (.+)$'"', path.read_text(), re.M):
        title = title.lower().replace(' ', '-')
        result.add(''.join(c for c in title if c in '-_' or unicodedata.category(c)[0] in 'LN'))
    return result
count = 0
for path in files:
    for link in re.findall(r'\\]\\((["'^)]+)'"\\)', path.read_text()):
        if '://' in link:
            continue
        target, _, anchor = link.partition('#')
        dest = path.parent / target if target else path
        assert dest.exists(), (path, link)
        if anchor:
            assert anchor in anchors(dest), (path, link)
        count += 1
original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:DEVELOPMENT.md'], text=True)
history = original[original.index('## 初期整備で確認した範囲'):]
assert Path('DEVELOPMENT-HISTORY.md').read_text().endswith(history)
changed = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--name-only'], text=True).splitlines()
assert set(changed) <= {'README.md', 'DEVELOPMENT.md', 'scripts/README.md'}
print(f'PASS: {count} local links and anchors; original historical sections preserved verbatim; tracked changes limited to documentation.')
